query:
SELECT COUNT(a.created_at) AS "count!"
                FROM unnest($2::BIGINT[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS w(win, ord)
                LEFT JOIN registration_attempt a
                  ON a.ip_bucket = $1
                 AND a.created_at >= now() - w.win * INTERVAL '1 second'
                GROUP BY w.ord
                ORDER BY w.ord
